proposals.before: On jiawu court envoys were commissioned to ennoble the late Princess Meng of Fortune and Celebration as Long Princess Yongshun of Jin; Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was sent to the Western Circuit to perform the investiture.
proposals.after: On jiawu court envoys were commissioned to ennoble the late Long Princess of Fortune and Celebration, Lady Meng, as Long Princess Yongshun of Jin; the Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was sent to the Western Circuit to perform the investiture.
proposals.reason: 孟氏 marks the Meng surname/clan affiliation of the late long princess, not a given name "Meng" as "Princess Meng"; 福慶長公主 is her prior title.

proposals.before: On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;
proposals.after: On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Marshal (Taiwei), and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;
proposals.reason: 檢校太尉 is Acting Grand Marshal/Grand Commandant (Taiwei), not Grand Preceptor (太師); the same mistranslation appears for parallel appointments.

proposals.before: On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yazhou.
proposals.after: On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yanzhou (Yan/Salt prefecture, 鹽州).
proposals.reason: 鹽州 is Yanzhou/Yanzhou (Salt Prefecture), not Yazhou; the English conflates 鹽州 with a different place.

proposals.before: On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou, Military Affairs Commissioners, were additionally made Palace Attendants while retaining their posts.
proposals.after: On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou, Military Affairs Commissioners, were additionally made Palace Attendants while retaining their posts.
proposals.reason: 趙延壽 is Zhao Yanshou; English incorrectly shortens to Zhao Shou.

decisions.reason: 福慶長公主 is the late princess's prior title, while 孟氏 identifies her as Lady Meng; the revision restores that distinction.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 冊故福慶長公主孟氏為晉國雍順長公主

decisions.after: On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Commandant, and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;
decisions.reason: 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor; 'Grand Commandant' is also the terminology already used elsewhere in this edition.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 檢校太尉、兼侍中馬希振為洪州節度使

decisions.after: On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yanzhou.
decisions.reason: 鹽州 is Yanzhou, not Yazhou; an explanatory parenthesis is unnecessary in the running annal.
The Chinese explicitly gives 趙延壽; the existing Zhao Shou drops the middle character of the attested personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 樞密使範延光、趙延壽並加兼侍中
